text: This exploratory study compared the growth of basil seedlings under red and blue LED light in a controlled indoor setting. Plants were monitored for height, leaf count, and overall vigor over several weeks. Seedlings under blue light appeared more compact, while those under red light tended to grow taller. Because the sample was small, these observations are preliminary and warrant replication with larger groups.
task: Write an abstract for a fictional small study comparing plant growth under two colors of light. Mention the small sample and avoid invented numerical results.
